prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one new precise high-fidelity flat UI comparison board for an EXISTING saved-note-history structured diff component in DooKnow. Exactly two independent LOCAL component specimens side by side: A a wide content region at least600px-equivalent, B a320px-equivalent narrow content region. Only tiny A/B outside the product; no device/browser/complete modal/sidebar/navigation, no explanatory headings or dimensions in the UI. White/light gray flat surfaces, fine #e6e9f1 borders, restrained8px corners, #272b3a text, #657084 secondary, #4566c6 selection with pale #edf1ff. Normal readable typography; diff code uses monospace and naturally wraps; do not make the narrow specimen a tiny full-page thumbnail.

Both represent a successfully parsed READY comparison, same file label "示例笔记", exactly ONE deletion and ONE insertion. At top each has the real saved-history tab pair "差异对比" (active) then "历史原文" (inactive). Beside them the separate real layout buttons "逐行" and "左右对照"; can naturally wrap at narrow width.
A: "左右对照" is selected and enabled, "逐行" unselected enabled.
B: "逐行" selected, "左右对照" unselected and visibly DISABLED pale gray. Do NOT draw a narrow-window explanation: the actual history parent hides that hint.
Next actual file heading "示例笔记" with computed count exact text "新增 1 行，删除 1 行".
Then actual structured diff table:
A has FOUR headers in this exact order: "旧行" | "旧内容" | "新行" | "新内容".
One hunk header row spans all4 columns: "@@ -1 +1 @@".
One paired change row: old line1 with exact code "-旧内容" on pale red; new line1 with exact code "+新内容" on pale green.
B has THREE headers in order: "旧行" | "新行" | "内容".
Same spanning hunk header "@@ -1 +1 @@".
Two actual unified rows: first old line1, new line empty, content "-旧内容" with pale red; second old line empty, new line1, content "+新内容" with pale green.
Keep ASCII minus and plus as visible parts of the readonly code content. No double-count or context line. The same exact1-insert/1-delete count in both views.
Below each table retain one default-collapsed native disclosure, right-pointing marker and exact label "原始差异". Its raw code body is NOT visible while collapsed.
No copy/download/restore/close/OK/search/filter action. No progress, loading/error notice, parser unavailable or retry button: this is ready, not fallback. No Git commit selector, author, push control or saved-version picker in these local crops. No editable inputs, no source/API/role metadata. All buttons shown are existing layout/tab/disclosure controls, not invented functionality. Keep every table header, count, line number, source sign and control legible and inside its component. External comparison spacing is not a new application card workflow.
